items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Lines Up $25 Billion Bond Offering For AI Expansion
items.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS: GOOGL) announces a US$25b bond offering to fund AI expansion following its first recorded period of negative free cash flow. The debt deal marks a shift in Alphabet's capital structure as it leans on bond markets to support large scale AI infrastructure investment. The move comes while Google DeepMind faces executive turnover, leadership reshuffles and delays in certain AI model releases.
